Description: Set the name of the server as it appears publicly
DefaultValue: AMP Powered ARK: Survival Ascended Server

Description: Sets the player welcome message (MOTD)
Sets the time period for display of the MOTD
Sets the map for the server. If Custom is selected, Custom Map Name must also be set
Sets a custom map for the server. "Custom" type must be selected under Map, and the CurseForge Project ID for the map included under Mods List

If set, enables automatic mod downloading, updating and loading (on server start). Specify the relevant mods under Mods List. Don't enable this setting if no mods are specified under Mods List or the server will not start

Comma-separated and ordered list of [CurseForge Project IDs](https://www.curseforge.com/ark-survival-ascended) for mods (including events) to install and load on server start (map mods will not load unless also named as a "Custom" map under Custom Map Name). Requires Use Mods to be enabled

If enabled, this option activates the -passivemods function, allowing specified mods to load their data while disabling their functionality (even if the mods are listed under Mods List). Don't enable this setting if no mods are specified under Passive Mods List or the server will not start

Comma-separated and ordered list of [CurseForge Project IDs](https://www.curseforge.com/ark-survival-ascended) for mods to be loaded in passive mode, disabling their functionality while retaining their data. Requires Use Passive Mods to be enabled. When enabled, at least one mod ID must be specified, or the server will not start
If set, crossplay mods will be disabled on the server
If particular event colors are selected, then dinos may spawn with those colors

See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON password. The RCON password is also used in the in-game console for players to access administrator commands (unless they are whitelisted)
Sets the password for players to join the server
If set, only players with EOS IDs listed under Whitelisted Players or Whitelisted Players Above Limit can join the server
List of EOS IDs for normal whitelisted players. EOS IDs can be found by using the 'whoami' command, by viewing another player's character in spectator mode, or by inspecting the server's log files
List of EOS IDs for whitelisted players who can join the server even if the number of player slots is exhausted
Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server. May be exceeded as a result of players listed under Whitelisted Players Above Limit
If set, BattlEye will be disabled on the server

List (separated by +, such as: XSX+PS5) of the game client platforms supported by the server. 'PC' = Steam/PC, 'XSX' = Xbox, 'WINGDK' = Microsoft Store/PC, 'PS5' = PlayStation 5, 'ALL' = all platforms. Crossplay will be enabled if more than one platform is specified
Sets a banlist to disallow access to the server to specified players (identified by Steam64 ID). Use either the global banlist of ARK, or a custom banlist URL
If set, all admin commands used will be logged to in-game chat
If set, characters that have not moved or interacted within the Kick Idle Players Period will be kicked from the server
Sets the time period after which characters that have not moved or interacted will be kicked (if Kick Idle Players is enabled)
Sets the interval for automatic saves. 0 = constant saving, 9000000 = effectively disabled
If set, prevents the server from shutdown if its start-time takes more than 2700 seconds (45 minutes). Useful for servers with big saves or very slow machines
If set, prevents ARK data usage between single player and servers that do not have a Cluster ID set. Even with a Cluster ID set, it is suggested to enable this option
Sets the language of the server
Sets whether ARK should automatically select the public IP advertised for the server, or whether it should use the IP set under Server Public IP
Sets the public IP advertised for the server, if "Manual" is selected as the Public IP Selection Mode. Useful if the host network has multiple public IPs, or the server is behind a public proxy
If set, the server's game analytics reporting will be disabled

Sets custom [command line flags](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_configuration_(Survival_Ascended%29) for the server (those that start with a - (dash)). Include the dash and separate with a space. Don't use flags already in AMP's settings!

Sets custom [command line options](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Server_configuration_(Survival_Ascended%29) for the server (those that start with a ? (question mark)). Include the question mark but do not separate with a space. Don't use options already in AMP's settings!
If set, PvE will be enabled, and PvP disabled

If set, the Offline Raiding Prevention option will be enabled, so that when all tribe members are logged off, tribe characters, creatures and structures become invulnerable. Creature starvation still applies, and characters and creatures can still die if drowned
Sets the time period after which Offline Raiding Prevention becomes active for tribes/players and related creatures/structures. Recommended to set a minimum for performance reasons
If set, enables hardcore mode, meaning player characters revert to level 1 upon death
If enabled, sets the server difficulty level to the value set under "Difficulty Override Level". This is generally the recommended way to set the difficulty level

Sets the value of the difficulty level to be applied if "Override Official Difficulty" is enabled, allowing the level to go above the default 4.0. Value of 5.0 will allow common creatures to spawn up to level 150. Be careful not to go too high!
As an alternative to using "Override Official Difficulty", this setting sets the difficulty offset, which is used to calculate the [difficulty level](https://ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Difficulty)
If set, each player will be shown a crosshair
If set, the HUD (head-up display) will always be disabled for non-tribe owned NPCs
If set, shows each player their own precise position when they view their map
If set, the third person camera is enabled
If set, damage caused is shown in a RPG style pop-up text
If set, player characters spawn and respawn without the wake-up animation
If set, disables creature mate boosting
If set, enables optional hit markers for ranged attacks
Sets the maximum number of tamed creatures on the server. This is a global cap
Sets the maximum number of tamed creatures that a tribe is allowed to have. 0 = disabled
Sets the maximum number of slots for uploaded creatures
Sets the maximum number of structures that can be constructed within a certain (currently hard-coded) range
Sets the maximum number of slots for uploaded items and resources
Sets the maximum number of players in each tribe. 0 = no limit, 1 = tribes effectively disabled
If set, tribes will be prevented from creating alliances
If set, prevents friendly fire among tribe-mates, tribe-dinosaurs and tribe-structures on PvP servers
If set, prevents friendly fire among tribe-mates, tribe-dinosaurs and tribe-structures on PvE servers
If set, allows use of console command "gamma" in PvP mode
If set, prevents use of console command "gamma" in PvE mode
If set, players will always be notified if someone joins the server
If set, voice chat will be enabled globally
If set, only players near each other can see each other's chat messages
If set, allows building in caves in PvE mode
If set, flying dinosaurs will be permitted to pick up wild creatures in PvE mode
If set, players and non-flyers can have their movement speed levelled up. Disabled by default due to engine limitations. Use with caution
If set, flyers will always be allowed into caves (flyers are able to go into caves by default on custom maps)
If set, wild creatures will not be spawned in the server. For an existing server, existing creatures need to be wiped with the admin command "destroywilddinos"

DisplayName: Force Wild Creature Respawn On Start
Description: If set, all wild creatures that are not currently tamed will be destroyed on server start
If set, the Tek Railgun will be disabled in PvP mode
If set, loot crates will not spawn. Artifact crates will still spawn

DisplayName: Player Radius For No Resource Replenish
Description: Sets the distance around players where resources are not allowed to grow back. Values higher than 1 increase it, values between 0 and 1 reduce it

DisplayName: Structure Radius For No Resource Replenish
Description: Sets the distance around structures where resources are not allowed to grow back. Values higher than 1 increase it, values between 0 and 1 reduce it
If set, the gradual (7 days) decay (or unclaiming) of creature ownership will be disabled in PvE mode. Otherwise, every creature can be claimed by any player
If set, the gradual decay (or unclaiming) of creature ownership will be enabled in PvP mode while Offline Raid Prevention is active
If set, wild and riderless dinosaurs can take damage from passive defence structures like spikewalls
If set, diseases will be completely disabled on the server
If set, diseases will not be permanent (they will be lost on respawn)
If set, enables anyone to "take care" of baby creatures (cuddle etc), not just whomever imprinted on it
If set, disables the creature imprinting player Stat Bonus (where whomever specifically imprinted on the creature, and raised it to have an imprinting quality, gets extra damage/resistance buff)
If set, allows Titanosaurs to be permanently tamed (ie they can be fed). Note: The Island only spawns a maximum of 3 Titanosaurs, so 3 tamed ones will ultimately block any more spawning
If enabled, more than one C4 can be attached per creature
If set, fog is disabled
If enabled, supply drops will be in random locations
If set, all engrams are unlocked for every player, regardless of level
If set, Mindwipe Tonic can be used repeatedly without the usual 24 hour cooldown
If set, a Creative Mode button is shown in the pause menu
If set, Genesis missions are disabled
If set, a beam of light marks the location of a player's corpse after death
Overrides the maximum experience points a player can earn. 0 uses the game default
Overrides the maximum experience points a dinosaur can earn. 0 uses the game default
If set, players cannot tame dinosaurs
If set, players cannot ride dinosaurs
If set, the tamed dinosaur limit only counts dinosaurs with platform saddles and rafts
If set, tamed dinosaurs that have decayed and become claimable are destroyed when the server loads
Sets the maximum number of alliances a tribe can form or join
Sets how many entries are kept in each tribe log
Sets the time a tribe must wait between name changes
If set, tribes can declare war on each other in PvE mode
If set, an agreed tribe war can be cancelled before it starts in PvE mode
If set, the server switches to PvE mode between the Auto PvE start and stop times
If set, the Auto PvE timer uses the server's system time instead of the in-game time
Sets when PvE mode starts, in seconds after midnight, when the Auto PvE timer is enabled
Sets when PvE mode stops, in seconds after midnight, when the Auto PvE timer is enabled
Sets how long a player is invincible after logging in when offline raid prevention is enabled
If set, players who are killed repeatedly by other players within the check period must wait longer to respawn
Sets the time window in which repeated PvP deaths increase the respawn interval
Sets how much the respawn interval is multiplied for each repeated PvP death
Sets the base respawn interval that is multiplied for repeated PvP deaths
Sets the cooldown between uses of the implant's respawn option
Sets the in-game hour when the server starts. -1 keeps the saved time
Sets how much durability charged batteries lose each second while powering structures

DisplayName: Allow Hiding Damage Source From Logs
Description: If set, the source of damage can be hidden from tribe logs
If set, players can create custom recipes (cooking and brewing)

Sets the scaling factor for the server day/night cycle. The default value 1 sets the same speed as a singleplayer game, ie 1 minute real time = approx 28 minutes server time. A scale of 0.035 would set a day/night cycle of approx 24 hours real time
Sets the scaling factor for the length of each server day, relative to the length of each night. Lowering this value increases the day length
Sets the scaling factor for the length of each server night, relative to the length of each day. Lowering this value increases the night length

Sets the scaling factor for experience (XP) received by players, tribes and dinosaurs for various actions. The default value 1 provides the same experience as a singleplayer game. Higher values increase XP amounts awarded, lower values decrease it
Sets the scaling factor for player characters' food consumption. Higher values increase food consumption (player characters get hungry faster)
Sets the scaling factor for player characters' water consumption. Higher values increase water consumption (player characters get thirsty faster)
Sets the scaling factor for player characters' health recovery. Higher values increase the recovery rate (player characters heal faster)
Sets the scaling factor for player characters' stamina consumption. Higher values increase stamina consumption (player characters get tired faster)
Sets the scaling factor for the damage that players cause with their attacks. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values increase damage, lower values decrease it

Sets the scaling factor for players' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack
Sets the scaling factor for creatures' food consumption. Higher values increase food consumption (creatures get hungry faster)
Sets the scaling factor for creatures' health recovery. Higher values increase the recovery rate (creatures heal faster)
Sets the scaling factor for creatures' stamina consumption. Higher values increase stamina consumption (creatures get tired faster)
Sets the scaling factor for the damage that wild creatures cause with their attacks. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values increase damage, lower values decrease it

Sets the scaling factor for wild creatures' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack
Set the scaling factor for the unclaiming speed of creatures in PvE mode. Requires Disable PvE Creature Decay to be off

Sets how resources regrow closer or farther away from structures. Values higher than 1.0 increase the distance around structures where resources are not allowed to grow back. Values between 0 and 1.0 reduce it

Sets the scaling factor for structures' damage resistance when attacked. The default value 1 causes normal damage. Higher values decrease resistance, increasing damage per attack. Lower values increase it, reducing damage per attack
Sets the scaling factor for the maximum number of structures placeable on platform saddles and rafts. NOTE: high values may lead to lag

Sets the scaling factor for yields from all harvesting activities (chopping down trees, picking berries, carving carcasses, mining rocks, etc). Higher values increase the amount harvested with each strike
Sets the scaling factor for the "health" of harvestable items (trees, rocks, carcasses, etc). Higher values increase the number of strikes needed to destroy them, increasing harvest yields
Sets the scaling factor for the resource node respawn rate (trees, rocks, bushes, etc). Lower values cause nodes to respawn more frequently
Sets the scaling factor for creature taming speed. Higher values make taming faster
Sets the scaling factor for swim speed, relative to the level spent in oxygen
Sets the scaling factor for the global item stack size. All default stack sizes will be multiplied by this value (excluding items that have a stack size of 1 by default)
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly the food drains on "raid dinos" (eg Titanosaurus)
Sets the scaling factor for experience received for kills
Sets the scaling factor for experience received for harvesting
Sets the scaling factor for experience received for crafting
Sets the scaling factor for experience received for special events
Sets the scaling factor for the bonus that the crafting skill stat gives to crafted items
Sets the scaling factor for damage players deal to harvestable resources
Sets the scaling factor for damage dinosaurs deal to harvestable resources
Sets the scaling factor for damage turrets deal to dinosaurs
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly wild dinosaurs get hungry, which affects taming time
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly wild dinosaurs lose torpor
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly tamed dinosaurs get hungry
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly tamed dinosaurs lose torpor
Sets the scaling factor for the time between feedings when passively taming. Lower values make passive taming faster
Sets the scaling factor for the time between dinosaur matings. Lower values allow mating more often
Sets the scaling factor for the time between unfertilised eggs being laid. Lower values make eggs appear more often
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly fertilised eggs hatch. Higher values make eggs hatch faster
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly baby dinosaurs grow up. Higher values make them mature faster
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly baby dinosaurs eat
Sets the scaling factor for the time between imprinting cuddles. Lower values make cuddles more frequent
Sets the scaling factor for how long after a cuddle is due before imprinting quality starts to drop
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly imprinting quality drops after the grace period
Sets the scaling factor for how much imprinting each cuddle gives
Sets the scaling factor for the stat bonus that imprinting gives. 0 disables the bonus
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly crops grow
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly crops rot
Sets the scaling factor for the time between defecations. Lower values make it more frequent
Sets the scaling factor for how quickly player hair grows. 0 stops hair growth
Sets the scaling factor for the quality of items found in supply crates
Sets the scaling factor for the quality of items caught by fishing
Sets the scaling factor for how long perishable items take to spoil. Higher values make them last longer
Sets the scaling factor for how long dropped items stay before disappearing
Sets the scaling factor for how long corpses stay before disappearing
Sets the scaling factor for how long player corpses and their dropped item boxes last
Sets the scaling factor for the effectiveness of custom recipes
Sets the scaling factor for how much the crafting skill stat affects custom recipes
Sets the scaling factor for damage to structures built in cave PvP zones
If set, enables the structure stasis grid to improve server performance on large bases with lots of players. Structures are loaded based on grids with players. Not recommended for modded servers
If set, the gradual (7 days) decay of player structures will be disabled in PvE mode
If set, turret and spike structures will be buildable and functional on platform saddles

DisplayName: Disable Building In Rich Resource Areas
Description: If set, completely disables building in specific resource-rich areas, in particular setup on The Island around the major mountains

DisplayName: Allow PvE Structures At Supply Drops
Description: If set, building near supply drop points will be allowed in PvE mode
If set, allows for structures to clip into the terrain
If set, the timer on the quick pick-up system will be disabled
Sets the quick pick-up hold duration. 0 = instant pick-up
Sets the amount of time after placement that quick pick-up is available
Sets the decay time for lone foundations and pillars when fast decay of unsnapped structures is enabled
If set, structures can be built in areas where building is normally blocked
If set, building is blocked in the mission areas of Genesis maps
If set, more than one floor can be built on platform saddles

DisplayName: Allow Unaligned Basing On Flyer Platforms
Description: If set, dinosaurs can stand on flying platform saddles (eg Quetzal) without being aligned with them
Sets the scaling factor for how far structures can extend from platform saddles
If set, limits the number of turrets that can be placed within the turret range
Sets the radius used to count turrets for the turret limit
Sets the maximum number of turrets within the turret limit range
If set, the turret limit also applies to turrets placed before the limit was set
If set, the use of a server cluster will be enabled. Requires Cluster Directory Override and Cluster ID to be set

Sets the path to a shared cluster directory for a server cluster. The cluster directory must be accessible to all cluster servers. If the server is in Docker, the directory must be mounted in the container. Requires Enable Cluster to be set
Sets the cluster ID for a server cluster. The cluster ID must be the same on all servers in the cluster. Requires Enable Cluster to be set
If set, prevents the download of characters from a cluster to the server
If set, prevents the download of survivors from a cluster to the server
If set, prevents the download of items from a cluster to the server
If set, prevents the download of tamed creatures from a cluster to the server
If set, prevents the upload of survivors from the server to a cluster
If set, prevents the upload of items from the server to a cluster
If set, prevents the upload of tamed creatures from the server to a cluster

If set, a player's character profile file (.arkprofile) will not be saved separately from the map save (.ark), nor its backup. When necessary (such as a character just transferred or a new character has been created), a temporary character profile file is created and kept until next world-save. Tribe profiles are stored in a different format (.arktributetribe)

If set, non-stored data (default save behaviour of unofficial and legacy) will be converted to stored data (default save behaviour of official non-legacy) at next world-save. It will not delete older character profile saves. Requires Use Unified Save Data to be enabled

If set, the server will fully mimic official (non-legacy) servers on handling player characters data, adding permanent character profile backup files separately from the world-save. Requires Use Unified Save Data to be enabled
If set, dinosaurs native to other maps can be downloaded on this map
Sets the cooldown before a downloaded dinosaur can be uploaded again
Sets whether to run the vanilla server or the [ServerAPI launcher](https://github.com/ArkServerApi/AsaApi). NOTE: Update the server after selecting the ServerAPI launcher
